title: Deichmann online shop data breach, Nov 2026

subject.name: Deichmann
subject.about: Deichmann is a shoe retailer with about 4,700 stores in 36 countries, about 1,300 of them in Germany, and around 50,000 employees. People buy shoes from it in its stores and through its online shops.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Deichmann, Snipes, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Deichmann is one of Europe's largest shoe retailers, and notices cover its German, UK and Austrian online shops. It calls the scope limited and has given no count.
who_is_affected: Some customers who bought from Deichmann's online shops in Germany, the UK and Austria, and, dpa reports, some Snipes customers. Those affected are being emailed. Watch for fake messages that quote real orders; Deichmann never asks for passwords or payment data.

known.text: Deichmann says unauthorised persons got into selected customer data from purchases in its online shop.
Names, billing and delivery addresses, invoices, email addresses, phone numbers and the chosen payment method may be affected.
Deichmann says passwords, account logins, card numbers and PayPal logins were not affected.
It says it closed the weakness, informed the authorities and filed a criminal complaint.

not_known.text: How many customers are affected, and when the access happened.
Who was behind it, and what weakness was used.
